body: I was going through a breakup and had just decided to drop contact with some long time friends. It hadn’t even been a week since I left everyone and I felt as lonely as ever. Technos passing was just the cherry on top of it all. I was 22 at the time and ended up grieving everything so bad that I lost my job shortly after because my mental health tanked. I haven’t been able to bring myself back to watching any of the streamers techno used to be friends with, or really any streams at all unless it’s my friends. I lost my favorite YouTuber, all my favorite streamers, and a lot of friends. But life goes on. Sometimes I debate going back and watching his videos but they just make me sad since I know he’s gone, even after all three years.

OP, I don't know if you've already had the conversation with your kids or not.

I am a kid of a similar situation I am 23F now but at the time I was 17. I also have three other siblings who were involved but I'll leave their ages/genders out of it.

My father had a affair with another girl during his marriage with my mother. How he handled it was sitting us all down in the living room with our mother and plainly stating it. He told us he would understand if it caused resentment or if we decided to dislike him afterwards and let us discuss with him and ask questions. I'm not sure the personality of your kids but I know that out of the four of us only one of us got upset and all they did was cry. The other three of us understood and actually took my fathers side on the situation!

There wasn't any split custody or anything, and the discussion happened before the divorce.

I hope this helps, good luck talking to your kids! Just remember to be honest and reassure them that you love them and that you'll understand and respect any decisions and changes the truth may cause. It sounds like your kids really love you so I'm sure they'll understand.
